docs.description: Public docs site: the harness-map --docs-only build, static HTML on Vercel, deployed with the CLI from a clean checkout of the commit.

rules: Smoke: the page loads, version.json matches the deployed commit, the wheel popover and the skill reader open.

services.name: site
services.runtime: Static site from harness_map.py --docs-only: index.html, skills/<name>/, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, icon.png, version.json; no build on Vercel
notes: Releases and deploys are manual through .claude/skills/release (no CI deploy): it tags the next version (feat minor, fix and others patch, ! or BREAKING CHANGE major), publishes the GitHub release, checks docs coverage, builds the site at that version, deploys it with the local Vercel CLI, and checks version.json equals the tagged commit.
The deploy commands here redeploy a commit without a new release; remove the deploy worktree afterwards: git worktree remove .agents/deploy/<sha>.
Google Search Console: --gsc-token (or GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION) adds the HTML-tag token; the release skill carries over the live site's token; the sitemap is /sitemap.xml.
